blocks.text: listen for key [KEY_ID] set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to [VALUE]
blocks.description: Registers or replaces a target-owned key binding.

blocks.text: stop listening for key [KEY_ID] for this target
blocks.description: Removes this target's binding for one physical key code.

blocks.text: stop all key listeners registered by this target
blocks.description: Removes every key binding owned by the current target.

blocks.text: listen for touch on this sprite set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to [VALUE]
blocks.description: Registers or replaces the current sprite or clone's pointer binding.

blocks.text: stop listening for touch on this sprite
blocks.description: Removes the current target's pointer binding.

blocks.text: listen for accumulated pose [POSE_NAME] set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to [VALUE]
blocks.description: Registers or replaces a target-owned accumulated pose binding.

blocks.text: stop listening for accumulated pose [POSE_NAME] for this target
blocks.description: Removes this target's binding for one accumulated pose name.

blocks.text: stop all pose listeners registered by this target
blocks.description: Removes every accumulated pose binding owned by the current target.

blocks.text: stop all input listeners registered by this target
blocks.description: Removes every key, pointer, and accumulated pose binding owned by the current target.
